safety_verdicts.content: Patient has needed to use the blue inhaler twice a day.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold specifies blue inhaler needed twice daily; generated only states 'daily' use without the twice-daily frequency.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Reliever (salbutamol) frequency is a key marker of asthma control and exacerbation severity; documenting only “daily” instead of “twice daily” can underestimate symptom burden and delay appropriate step-up care. This could lead to insufficient monitoring or treatment escalation during an acute worsening.
